cues.text: Footage from a security camera looks down on a lounge in the dorm. Koromaru walks up toward the camera and turns around beneath it. Fuuka, Yukari and Aigis walk into view and gather around Koromaru.
Aigis steps away from the others and looks straight up at the camera.
Yukari and Fuuka spin around and stare up at the camera.
Yukari, furious, turns on her heel and storms off, and Fuuka hurries after her, leaving Aigis and Koromaru under the camera.
